title: Legal AI vendor fact
description: One row per fact a vendor states on a public page about its own product: what the page says, where, when we read it, and an archived copy. Facts are not copyrightable; the quote (≤ 25 words) identifies the statement, it does not reproduce the page. 'not-found' rows record that we looked and the page did not say — the absence is itself the fact.

value.description: normalised value: tri-state yes/no/unknown for booleans as strings 'yes'|'no'; lists for residency/providers; strings for prices and terms; null when not-found

status.description: stated = the page says it in words; implied = follows from a badge/logo/list without a sentence; not-found = we read the relevant pages and none addresses it; contradictory = two vendor pages disagree (explain in note)

quote.description: ≤ 25 words, verbatim, in quotation marks; null for not-found

source_url.description: the vendor page read (or the most relevant one, for not-found)

pages_checked.description: for not-found rows: every vendor page read

page_dated.description: 'last updated' date printed on the page, if any (YYYY-MM-DD)
